description: Adds a responsive 2.5D isometric IIS architecture diagram to Configs with animated request flow, layered entry-point filters (URL Rewrite, redirects, IP restrictions, Request Filtering, authentication, ARR routing), web/FTP sites, application pools with status, binding ports, virtual-directory endpoint trees, ARR server farms and routing, database connection lines, selectable elements with a default-diff App pool/ASP.NET/IIS settings balloon and optional web.config attachment, static bundled assets and references, and a 3 web + 2 FTP synthetic sample. Configs is now the first tab after Home, and every page gets a round scroll-to-top button. Configs now opens with the schema-analysis note and jump links to the applicationHost.config and web.config findings. Sample-data notices on W3SVC, HTTPERR, Events, FREB and Configs gain a dashed drop area with Add files and file-type guidance.
